Mikey Musumeci Slicin’ Calves.overview: Mikey Musumeci's calf slicer course, three parts (about 1.5 hours). Part 1 covers his main calf slicer approach and its safety considerations. Part 2 covers a different way to calf slice, including from single leg X. Part 3 covers another calf slicer configuration and the pros, cons and differences between them.
Mikey Musumeci Slicin’ Calves.for: No-gi grapplers who want the calf slicer as a reliable finish.
key: Calf slicer from single leg X

Mindset - Jiu Jitsu Accelerator by Kenda.overview: Kendall Reusing on building your own jiu-jitsu roadmap, three parts. Part 1 covers the concept of working backwards from where you want to end up. Part 2 covers building a 'tree' of match-ending positions and training your game plan in a class setting. Part 3 covers adapting the plan for gi and no-gi and building a six-month roadmap.
Mindset - Jiu Jitsu Accelerator by Kenda.for: Anyone wanting to organise their learning, which suits this study-guide approach.
key: Training a game plan in class

NEW WAVE JIU JITSU - A NEW PHILOSOPHY OF.overview: John Danaher's no-gi positional escapes (your copy has 7 files; the publisher lists 8 parts). It covers why escapes are the basis of confidence, escaping mount (maximising physical potential, the kipping escape), escaping rear mount (the hand fight first), knee on belly escapes, side control escapes (kipping, reverse shrimping, the ankle trap escape, the tricep post escape), escaping turtle, and a summary of his philosophy of defensive responsibility.
key: Back escapes and the hand fight
